purpose: Document the leak found in the pre-tuning SVM pipeline and the honest numbers that replaced it. The LEAKED figures are not reproducible from the clean pipeline and are kept only for provenance -- do not cite them as current model performance.

leaked.features_note: includes ca and thal (invasive, not collected in production)
leaked.leak: StandardScaler/imputation fit on the full dataset before train/test split, so test-fold statistics leaked into preprocessing; roc_auc_full_fit is scored on data the scaler had already seen

clean.features_note: ca and thal excluded (invasive, unavailable in production)
clean.nested_loso_note: hyperparameter search re-run inside each leave-one-site-out fold; the only estimate where the held-out hospital never informed the search
clean.pooled_cv_caveat: sites mixed across folds; optimistic vs LOSO/external
clean.external_tehran_note: measured on the 7-feature reduced model (heart_reduced_tuned.pkl); the full 11-feature model cannot be scored on Tehran data because 4 of its features (MaxHR, Oldpeak, ST_Slope, ExerciseAngina) are absent from that cohort
clean.preprocessing: fit only on each fold's training split; no test-fold information leaks into imputation or scaling

why_not_directly_comparable: The leaked figure (0.957) is a single full-dataset fit scored on data its own preprocessing had already seen, using 2 features (ca, thal) the clean pipeline does not have. The clean figures (0.813 nested LOSO, 0.7634 external) are held-out estimates on an 11-feature model with fold-isolated preprocessing. The gap is the leak plus the feature difference, not a single correctable delta -- there is no valid way to re-score the leaked SVM on the clean split to get an apples-to-apples number.
